svg.text: GET /ui/api/events streams phase and log as text/event-stream. EventSource cannot send headers, so this is the only endpoint that accepts the credential in ?token=. The RoqueOS screen drops repeated phases, keeps at most 400 lines in the DOM and runs a 4 s poll as a safety net for when the stream does not come
